class.name: WaterMovementTransition2D
class.brief_description: Into the water and out again, in two dimensions.
class.description: The 2D twin of [WaterMovementTransition]. [CharacterMovementComponent2D] registers one by default, so dropping a [WaterVolume2D] into a level is the whole of making a character swim. The cost is one point query per tick per character; a game with no water anywhere can clear [member CharacterMovementComponent2D.transitions] to stop paying it. Entering is decided at the character's middle and leaving at its feet, and the asymmetry is deliberate: testing the same place in both directions makes a character treading water cross the line twice a second.
